title: Correlation
description: A recorded statistical association between two measured phenomena, WITHOUT asserting causation (CR-MET-012 section 6, Q22c). Correlation and Causal Hypothesis are distinct first-class constructs and MUST NOT be collapsed. A correlation records what was observed to co-vary; a causal hypothesis records an asserted mechanism. The Metric capability provides the semantic references and provenance needed by analytical services; it is NOT a causal inference engine. CONFUSION_GUARD is REQUIRED and MUST be false: a record that asserts a causal claim from co-variation alone is a governance failure.

source_phenomenon_ref.description: The first measured phenomenon in the association.

target_phenomenon_ref.description: The second measured phenomenon in the association.

coefficient.description: The correlation coefficient in the range -1 to 1. A coefficient near 0 means no linear association; near 1 a strong positive association; near -1 a strong negative association.

method.description: The statistical method used (pearson, spearman, kendall, mutual_information, and so on). Required so the result is reproducible.

sample_size.description: The number of paired observations the coefficient was computed from. A correlation computed from a small sample MUST declare it.

reporting_period_ref.description: The dea:ReportingPeriod over which the association was observed (CR-MET-011).

evidence_refs.description: The dea:MeasurementObservation records the coefficient was computed from.

confounder_candidates.description: Candidate confounding variables identified. A correlation WITH declared confounders is more honest than one without; absence of confounders is not evidence of their absence.

confusion_guard.description: MUST be false. This record asserts association ONLY. A correlation does not establish a causal mechanism. A dea:CausalHypothesis carries the asserted mechanism, separately, with explicit confidence.

strength.description: A plain-language classification of the coefficient magnitude.

directional_note.description: A note on direction of association. Association direction is NOT causal direction.

provenance_reference.description: Reference to the dea:Provenance record (CR-MET-011 section 5) for the computation.
